page_title: VER 1-2 TOR | Verona v Torino 12/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Livio Marinelli has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+6' Livio Marinelli pulls out a red card and his decision is clear. Thomas Henry (Verona) is sent off for mouthing off and can take an early bath. The manager looks really angry for his irresponsible behaviour.
90+4' Karol Linetty (Torino) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
90+3' The whistle blows and Tomas Suslov (Verona) is booked for an infringement.
90+3' The referee blows his whistle for unsporting behaviour, with Pietro Pellegri (Torino) the culprit. Pietro Pellegri (Torino) is punished with the yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' The Thomas Henry (Verona) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Livio Marinelli rules it out for a foul.
87' The substitution is prepared. Thomas Henry (Verona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Suat Serdar.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Verona comes to nothing.
85' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' 1 - 2 GOAL! Pietro Pellegri (Torino) finds the back of the net from close in from a very acute angle.
81' Substitution. Juan Cabal makes way for Ruben Vinagre (Verona).

80' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
79' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
77' 1 - 1 Valentino Lazaro plays a terrific cross over to Zannetos Savva (Torino), who finds some space inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
76' Adam Masina goes off the pitch and Alessandro Dellavalle (Torino) comes on.

76' A pass into the box finds Tomas Suslov (Verona) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic denies him. Verona will take a corner kick.
73' Diego Coppola (Verona) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but sends his shot slightly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
73' Verona try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
73' Livio Marinelli has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ivan Ilic (Torino). Verona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
69' Substitution. Zannetos Savva (Torino) has come on for Raoul Bellanova.
67' 1 - 0 Karol Swiderski (Verona) receives a precise pass inside the box from Suat Serdar and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the left side of the net. 1:0.

64' Tomas Suslov (Verona) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
63' Substitution. Daniel Silva (Verona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Giangiacomo Magnani walks off.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Darko Lazovic leaves the pitch and Tomas Suslov (Verona) comes on.
62' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Karol Swiderski (Verona) replacing Federico Bonazzoli.
56' Here comes a substitution. Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is brought on as a substitute for Ricardo Rodriguez.
56' Here is a change. Duvan Zapata is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Pietro Pellegri (Torino).
56' The referee signals a substitution. Karol Linetty (Torino) is brought on as a substitute for Mergim Vojvoda.
54' None of the Torino players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

50' Fabien Centonze (Verona) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
47' A corner kick by Verona is thwarted by the well prepared Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino).
47' Ondrej Duda (Verona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Now Verona have a corner.

47' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom right corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic made an astonishing save! Verona force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' The resulting set piece from Verona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' It must be a yellow card. It is. Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) receives the caution after an awful tackle.

43' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Livio Marinelli stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Torino are awarded a free kick.
40' Adrien Tameze (Torino) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
38' Adrien Tameze (Torino) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

38' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Tijjani Noslin (Verona). Livio Marinelli saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Tijjani Noslin (Verona) for a foul that he committed a little earlier. A free kick is awarded to Torino.
38' Suat Serdar (Verona) brings an opponent down and Livio Marinelli interrupts the game. Torino have a free kick.
35' Torino take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

30' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Duvan Zapata (Torino) sends a wild header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
30' It will be a corner kick for Torino.
28' A cross from Juan Cabal (Verona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
27' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Torino.
25' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Tijjani Noslin (Verona) after a cross from the side.
23' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Verona have a free kick.
19' Ondrej Duda (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul. Torino will take a free kick near the side line.
17' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to intercept the corner from Ondrej Duda (Verona).
16' The free kick is taken by Ondrej Duda (Verona), but ball is cleared.
16' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Livio Marinelli signals. It's a free kick to Verona, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
16' Ondrej Duda (Verona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
15' The corner is swung in but Verona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

13' Verona slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
10' Verona couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
6' Suat Serdar (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for an infringement. Torino will take a free kick.
5' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
4' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Torino will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Livio Marinelli.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text commentary, ladies and gentlemen! The starting lineups will be announced very soon, so just sit back and get ready to enjoy the action.
